messageHandlers.script:
'''
	Example payload: {"piercing":5,"cold":4}
	'''
	system.perspective.print(payload)
	
	# initialize variables
	damage = 0
	
	# loop through each damage type
	for damageType, value in payload.items():
		
		# apply resistance, vulnerability, immunity
#		damage += int(value * self.session.custom.damage[damageType])
		damage += value
	
	# remove temp hp first
	if self.session.custom.data.instants.tempHP > 0:
		
		# still have temp hp left
		if self.session.custom.data.instants.tempHP >= damage:
			self.session.custom.data.instants.tempHP -= damage
		
		# use all the temp hp
		else:
			self.session.custom.data.instants.currentHP = max(0, self.session.custom.data.instants.currentHP - damage + self.session.custom.data.instants.tempHP)
			self.session.custom.data.instants.tempHP = 0
	
	# no temp hp
	else:
		self.session.custom.data.instants.currentHP = max(0, self.session.custom.data.instants.currentHP - damage)
